_doc: every file in this folder: what it is, what made it, its bytes and sha256 (README.md has the story)

routes__routes_analysis.json.what: legs, ways, controls, junction turns, median crossings

routes__legs.geojson.what: the six legs (3 roads x cw / acw) as GeoJSON, WGS84

routes__mouths.json.what: side mouths, junction arms, median crossings, the census against the plan

routes__osm_diff.json.what: the fresh OSM against data/osm.expansion.json (2026-10-14) on the six legs and every way within 60 m

routes__stations.west.json.what: the station frame (midline every 2.5 m, y_3dep, re-read curb offsets and medians): the frame the paint was measured in; NOT Step 1's expansion.west.json

routes__profile_3dep.json.what: 3DEP 1 m every 25 m along each cw leg

revise__measure.json.what: 3DEP 1 m every 5 m: both carriageways and the midline, junction heights, max grades, the plan's checks

pipeline__mouth_geometry.json.what: the J2 / J3 arm conversions against Phase 1's records; the J6 / J7 arms

pipeline__osm_lamps_signals.json.what: OSM street lamps (none mapped here) and traffic signals

aerial__widths_eye.csv.what: curb to curb at the A4 stations and the junction arms: A4's eye width of record where it exists, this run's re-read (median, split, reread_*) everywhere; the automatic pavement read beside it
aerial__widths_eye.csv.from: EXPANSION-PHASE3-PLAN rev 2 A4 + scripts/eye_reread.json (p3x_crops.py panels) + p3x_profiles.py

aerial__widths_reread.json.what: this run's eye re-read with the panel geometry of every station

aerial__veg_bins.json.what: per piece / 250 m / side: [other, canopy, water, scrub] NAIP CIR samples of the 10-40 m band

aerial__veg_bins.calibration.json.what: the [invented] NDVI / brightness thresholds, picked on the Phase 2 legs against Phase 2's own bins

aerial__paint_west.json.what: the centre paint measured off NAIP every 2.5 m (tools/aerial_paint_north.py, unchanged, run on routes__stations.west.json; its intermediate_sha256_12 is that file's)

osm.expansion.json.what: fresh OSM roads + service ways, the exact box and query of data/osm.expansion.json

buildings.expansion.cache.json.what: fresh OSM building footprints, the box of data/buildings.expansion.cache.json (reaches -117.115)

buildings.expansion.cache.json.provenanc.what: the buildings fetch's own provenance (server, OSM timestamp, compare with the 2026-10-14 cache)
